title: Review of c30's BFF program soup: the negative replicates on fresh seed 3 (planted replicator fills the soup by epoch 250, exact ancestor gone by 1000, 90-93% of the soup self-replicating, functional top kind replaced 8 times in 12000 epochs), and the cohort novelty stays at or below drift-matched shadows (g=25: 6 significant kinds over 12 windows vs shadow means 0-1.6 per window; g=50: 1)
summary: c30's seeded.py (2^15 tapes, 32 planted replicators), functional.py and o_bff.py on seed 3, 12000 epochs. High-order entropy 2.64 at epoch 250 rising to 5.44; exact planted tapes 1183 at 250, 22 at 500, 0 from 1000. Functional kinds: 11748 against 242511 exact-tape kinds; replicating share 0.79 -> 0.90-0.93; per-1000-epoch top functional kind ids 1,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,7,8,9,9, top share 0.66 then 0.01-0.11; the commonest tape drifts 20 -> 37 bytes from the ancestor. Cohort novelty (99.9th-percentile a* over 8 census shadows): g=25 real 0-2 per window (6 total) vs shadow means 0-1.62 and maxima 0-5; g=50 real 1 total vs means up to 2.0. Labkit pack (seed 3, N=4096, 1500 epochs) runs.

observations.finding: data/cohort_g25_s3.json and data/cohort_g50_s3.json: real significant functional cohorts within the shadow envelope in every window; data/functional_summary.txt: turnover of the top functional kind with replication retained

seeds_run.result: pass: takeover by 250, ancestor lost by 1000, no cohort excess over drift-matched shadows

controls_run.finding: census shadows with g = 25 and 50 (o_bff.py, 8 shadows each)

verdicts.limitation: One new seed, 12000 epochs (c30 ran 20000). Two differences from c30's seed 0: diversification comes early (functional kinds per 1000-epoch window 145 -> 3048 by epoch 4000, then declining to ~800), not at ~8000; and in the last two windows only 60-20% of the 5 commonest tapes copy themselves exactly on random food (c30: 100%), although 90% of the soup still passes the replication test. Spontaneous soups not re-run.
